text:
Aisha (Product): Quick follow-up from the all-hands — can leadership confirm delivery windows for API stability, Console beta, and Optimize alpha? People asked about canary sizing and fallback policies during GA.

Evan (CEO): High-level yes — conservative windows: API GA early May, Console beta end of June, Optimize alpha mid-July. We'll lock exact dates next week after a short risk review. Note: Dedicated contracts may affect rollout sequencing. :eyes:

Sam (ENG-Platform): For canary we propose: 10% traffic, 2-week ramp, rollback if error rate > 5% or latency regresses > 20% p95. Need Product signoff on the numbers. Here's a draft ramp snippet:

```
# canary-policy.yaml
canary:
  start_percent: 1
  target_percent: 10
  ramp_days: 14
  rollback_if_error_rate_gt: 0.05
  rollback_if_p95_increase_pct_gt: 20
```

Priya (SRE): We also need SLA targets for GA to size Dedicated and alerting. Recommend SLOs: availability 99.9% and p95 latency < 200ms for short requests. Product: confirm which request classes map to these SLOs.

Jordan (DevEx): Console beta will include model catalog, rollout controls, and a simple cost recommendations panel. Optimize integrations (full evals + quant suggestions) will be opt-in later — initial beta is more about visibility and manual suggestions.

Aisha (Product): For Optimize alpha, can we confirm the minimum feature set? My ask: batching hints, quantization recommendations (profiles), and a small eval hook to surface regressions. Is eval-integration planned for alpha or v1?

Evan (CEO): Alpha should ship with batching hints and quant profiles. Eval-integration is important but schedule it for v1 so we don't block alpha. Prioritize stability and clear opt-in UX.

Sam (ENG-Platform): We'll need 3 canonical workloads to validate per-feature perf: short-chat, long-context summarization, and high-throughput embed batches. Product can you supply 3 prompts/examples each? We can run perf matrices and publish expected cost deltas.

Leah (Solutions): I can collect customer scenarios and owners. Tentative test cases: chatbot-short, doc-summarize-long, semantic-search-bulk. I'll send exact prompts by Friday.

deploy-bot: Deploy started for canary config namespace `canary-2027`, image: `rwd/runtime:stable-2027-05-01` :rocket:

Priya (SRE): Quick question on fallback order — our recommendation: 1) fall back to smaller/quantized model variant, 2) route to alternate region, 3) degrade streaming to non-streaming chunked responses. That gives best user experience vs cost tradeoff.

Sam (ENG-Platform): Agreed. We'll implement fallback mappings and an autoscaling burst cap. Also adding a safety throttle so customer traffic can't saturate Dedicated during a region outage.

Aisha (Product): Action items from thread:
- Aisha to publish exact dates by EOD Tue
- Jordan to share Console beta feature list draft by Wed
- Sam to post canary policy YAML and rollout playbook by Thurs
- Priya to propose SLO targets and alert runbooks by Thurs
- Leah to provide customer prompts/test-cases by Fri

Please ack if assigned. :thumbsup:

Jordan (DevEx): Ack — I'll post the beta feature doc in #eng-platform and link back here.

Sam (ENG-Platform): Ack, will post the YAML and sample metrics dashboard.

Priya (SRE): Ack, will draft SLOs and an incident playbook.

Leah (Solutions): Ack, collecting customer examples now.

Evan (CEO): Thanks all. Let's aim for clarity on dates so sales and partner teams can plan. I'll backstop if we need to prioritize specific contracts.

Aisha (Product): Thanks everyone — I'll compile this into a one-pager and ping leadership for signoff.
